versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the content-analysis skill.
- Extracts word/character counts, sentence and paragraph stats, and reading time.
- Identifies top 10 keywords (minimum 4 characters).
- Calculates simple sentiment score and labels text as positive, neutral, or negative.
- Offers structure and batch analysis with easy API and CLI usage.
- Extensible with domain sentiment keywords and basic entity extraction (emails, URLs, mentions, hashtags, currency).
